newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended easier against the key U.S. currency on Friday but was quoted firmer against other hard units in reflection of overseas market trends.
Dealers said the local unit touched a 10.8650/8800 low on the U.S. dollar before the central Reserve Bank came into the market selling money to a few banks, some of whom ended the day with surpluses.

"The Reserve Bank came in with money for a few banks and that stabilised the rates at their closing levels. Some people were actually even selling off their long positions at the end," one dealer commented.

The Zimbabwe dollar closed at 10.8600/8750 against the U.S. dollar, down from late Thursday's 10.8550/8700 but was firmer at 18.3120/3400 from 18.3600/3800 versus pound sterling, tracking a firmer U.S. dollar abroad.
It was at 6.8860/8990 from 6.8900/9100 against the mark and at 2.3220/3280 against South Africa's rand from 2.3300/3500.
